final: WITH cnt AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM cnt WHERE c IS NOT NULL), shares AS (SELECT cnt.account_id, cnt.c, 1.0 * cnt.c / tot.t AS s FROM cnt JOIN tot ON tot.t IS NOT NULL), avgs AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS a FROM shares WHERE s IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT shares.c, shares.s, shares.s - avgs.a AS d FROM shares JOIN avgs ON avgs.a IS NOT NULL WHERE shares.s > avgs.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(s), AVG(d) FROM kept
